create_HabitatSim_instance: create a HabitatSim instance with configs, scene path, physics config, seed, and noisy settings
reset_HabitatSim: reset the HabitatSim simulator to its initial state using the reset method
get_agents_HabitatSim: get the list of agent objects from the HabitatSim simulator using get_agents
get_sensors_HabitatSim: get the dictionary of sensor IDs and sensors from the HabitatSim simulator using get_sensors
set_seed_HabitatSim: set a new random seed on the HabitatSim simulator using the set_seed method
